name: Farmer Mike's UPick Fort Myers
description: Farmer Mike's UPick Fort Myers is a berry farm in Fort Myers, FL. Visitors come for Strawberries, Flowers, and Sunflowers, best in spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
